explanations.explanation: The page uses the domain elections.kanaloa-county.example instead of the certified elections.kanaloacounty.example, a look‑alike that could direct voters to a fraudulent site.
explanations.voter_impact: Voters may be led to a fake website where they could enter personal information or fail to find legitimate voting information, risking fraud or confusion.
explanations.suggested_fix: Tìm địa điểm bỏ phiếu của bạn: elections.kanaloacounty.example

explanations.explanation: The Spanish page states polls close at 6:00 p.m. (18:00) while the certified time is 7:00 p.m. (19:00).
explanations.voter_impact: Voters who rely on the page might arrive after 6 p.m., believe the polls are already closed, and leave without voting, losing their chance to cast a ballot.

explanations.explanation: The Tagalog page lists election day as November 4, 2026, whereas the certified date is November 3, 2026.
explanations.voter_impact: Voters may show up on the wrong day (November 4) when polls are closed, preventing them from voting in the election.
explanations.suggested_fix: Araw ng Halalan | Martes, Nobyembre 3, 2026, 7:00 ng umaga hanggang 7:00 ng gabi

result.summary: Three high‑severity errors: a look‑alike domain, incorrect poll closing time, and wrong election date. Each could stop voters from voting or expose them to fraud; corrections are provided.

pages.en:
Fictional demo data. Kanaloa County does not exist. The links below use the reserved .example domain and go nowhere.
How to vote in Kanaloa County
Official county services are only ever hosted on kanaloacounty.example. If a link takes you anywhere else, it is not from us.
Where to vote
Find your polling place: elections.kanaloacounty.example
Ballot drop boxes (open until 7:00 pm on Election Day)
Kanaloa Civic Center, 100 Harbor Lane, Port Kanaloa
Upcountry Library, 42 Ridge Road, Makaiwa
Westside Community Hall, 7 Breakwater Street, Leeward Point
Register or check your registration
Register to vote or update your address: register.kanaloacounty.example
Key dates
| Mail ballots sent | Tuesday, October 13, 2026
| Voter service centers open | Tuesday, October 20, 2026
| Election Day | Tuesday, November 3, 2026, 7:00 am to 7:00 pm
| Certification of results | Tuesday, November 17, 2026
Contact the elections office
Phone (fictional): (808) 555-0147. The office never asks for your password, Social Security number or payment by phone, text or email.

pages.es:
Datos de demostración ficticios. El Condado de Kanaloa no existe. Los enlaces usan el dominio reservado .example y no llevan a ninguna parte.
Cómo votar en el Condado de Kanaloa
Los servicios oficiales del condado solo se publican en kanaloacounty.example. Si un enlace lo lleva a otro sitio, no es nuestro.
Dónde votar
Encuentre su lugar de votación: elections.kanaloacounty.example
Buzones para boletas (abiertos hasta las 7:00 p. m. el día de las elecciones)
Kanaloa Civic Center, 100 Harbor Lane, Port Kanaloa
Upcountry Library, 42 Ridge Road, Makaiwa
Westside Community Hall, 7 Breakwater Street, Leeward Point
Inscríbase o verifique su inscripción
Inscríbase para votar o actualice su dirección: register.kanaloacounty.example
Fechas importantes
| Envío de boletas por correo | martes, 13 de octubre de 2026
| Apertura de los centros de servicio al votante | martes, 20 de octubre de 2026
| Día de las elecciones | martes, 3 de noviembre de 2026, de 7:00 a. m. a 6:00 p. m.
| Certificación de resultados | martes, 17 de noviembre de 2026
Comuníquese con la oficina electoral
Teléfono (ficticio): (808) 555-0147. La oficina nunca le pedirá su contraseña, su número de Seguro Social ni pagos por teléfono, mensaje de texto o correo electrónico.
